adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)` selects the target calendar via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, but the payload’s organizer attendee email is derived from `mainHostDestinationCalendar` which is always the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = ... ? calEventRaw.destinationCalendar : []`). With the diff making `destinationCalendar` an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` iterating over multiple destinations/credentials, events inserted into a non-first destination calendar will still use `destinationCalendar[0].externalId` for the organizer attendee email, matching the finding.
